title: Incompatible with docker-compose healthcheck: {}
body:
### Issue Description

`healthcheck: {}` in `docker compose` works without error.

`healthcheck: {}` in `podman compose` errors with `Error response from daemon: fill out specgen: must define a healthcheck command for all healthchecks`

Docker treats `{}` to mean "inherit the health check defined in the image" (if present, otherwise no healthcheck) whereas podman currently treats it as an invalid healthcheck definition and errors.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue:

`docker-compose.yml`
```
services:
  repro:
    image: busybox
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    healthcheck: {}
```

1. `podman compose up`


### Describe the results you received

```
[+] up 1/2
 ⠋ Container podman-repro-1 Creating                                                                                                                                                                                          0.0s
 ✘ service:repro:1          Error response from daemon: fill out specgen: must define a healthcheck command for all healthchecks                                                                                              0.0s
Error response from daemon: fill out specgen: must define a healthcheck command for all healthchecks
Error: executing /usr/local/bin/docker-compose up: exit status 1
```

### Describe the results you expected

The container should start successfully, with either inherited health check, or no health check if the image does not define one.
